DetailedNV.dc.html.title: 8 Detailed: Non Verbal on Q2 (unchanged module)

t1.text: Adaptive interview: existing rubric plus follow-ups (option 1)

n1.text: Wizard steps 1 to 3 (basis, job description, CV) are existing screens and are not redrawn.

n2.text: How it works. The checklist is VMock's existing question-type rubric, so the Level is calculated as today. Each element has three states: in your first answer, added when the interviewer asked, still missing. Q chips are the opening questions; follow-ups sit inside their question. Non Verbal and Delivery of Speech are unchanged and run on the whole question segment, follow-ups included.

n3.text: Every adaptive feedback field has a place. overall: How it went. Goal: pinned card. more_priorities: Overall Improvements (Content tag). jd_coverage, moments, ownership: Across the interview. question and resume_line: question bar. ratings with reason: What we checked chips. verdict: Content Strength badge. went_well and to_fix with quotes: Your first answer, plus transcript highlights. resume_mismatch: amber block. answer_plan and stronger_version: Next time. example_answer: Sample Response (scenario and technical only). too_short: board 9.

n4.text: Data for these boards (feedback version 9). ratings[].found and ratings[].quote: the three chip states and the quote under a chip. topics[].follow_ups: question, time, asked_for element, given. topics[].segment: start and end in the recording. topics[].jd_line: the 'From the job description' line. Still on VMock's side: a mapping from the engine's rubric elements to VMock's chip names, plus Non Verbal, Delivery, Word Usage & Tone and the Level.
